name: Imperial long-range rocket rifle
description: The Imperial long-range rocket rifle was a missile launcher used by the Galactic Empire during the Galactic Civil War. The rocket rifle was outdated by the time after the Battle of Endor, but was still utilized by an Imperial storm commando during an attack on Coronet City on the planet Corellia in 4 ABY. After the storm commando was killed in battle, the Rebel agent Ten Numb used the commando's rocket rifle to destroy an Imperial All Terrain Scout Transport.
